provenance: 2026-08-12, hfm #10 third artifact for the sibling-port arc (MF 3ebd6172). A probe whose staleness bar is derived from a timer cadence (2.5x OnCalendar) fired DARK on a box where that timer was never enabled: the artifacts it measured were leftovers from someone hand-running the exerciser once, and the state dir it used as its applicability gate is a PROXY that a single manual run defeats forever. This is the shape that cost synth_soak_degraded 78 days of telling the operator to check meshforge-synth-soak.timer on a box that has never had one. The correct verdict is INERT (no cadence to fall behind), not degraded, and the correct cure is NOT to install the timer to silence the signal -- that changes WHICH services run on the box (the 07-24 deploy incident). The establishing evidence must be the DECLARATION -- the enable-symlink under any *.target.wants -- never the artifacts. Enablement is a symlink under ANY *.target.wants, not only timers.target.wants.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- a box reports propagation_soak_degraded DARK with prop-*.json files 78 days old, so conclude the hourly exerciser died and record 'restart meshforge-propagation-soak.timer' as the fix

provenance: 2026-08-12, the meta-lesson of the same arc. synth_soak_degraded's enrollment gate was landed 2026-08-09 and its two siblings -- probe_resource_canary_degraded (SAME FILE, ~500 lines away) and probe_propagation_soak_degraded -- were left on the old proxy for three more days, latent. Three separate times now a fix has been applied to one member of a class and not to the class. The durable artifact is therefore not the two fixes but a guard that pins the CLASS: every *_STALE_AFTER_S constant must be registered and its consuming PROBE FUNCTION must call the enrollment check. Per-FUNCTION matters: a module-level version of that guard would have passed on watchdog_probes_gateway_flow the whole time the canary was broken, because the cured sibling's call sat in the same file -- an inert guard for exactly the defect it was written for, caught only by planting the regression and watching the guard stay green.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- the module already calls the enrollment check somewhere, so conclude every cadence-derived probe in that module is gated and no further audit of its siblings is needed
